name: AI Tools Directory
blurb: Commercial and open source AI products, with pricing, strengths, weaknesses, alternatives, and governance notes.

reading.body:
The AI Tools Directory is a hub with a single catalog listing 320 tools across 23 categories, 63 of which have in-depth profiles covering pricing, strengths, weaknesses, and governance notes.

The directory itself holds no tool entries; all content sits in the AI Tools Catalog child page. That catalog spans 320 tools across 23 categories, but only 63 have in-depth profiles, so most entries are names and categories rather than evaluated products.

For AI specifically, the 63 profiles include governance notes alongside pricing, strengths, and weaknesses, which matters for enterprise buyers who need to assess risk before deployment. The data does not cover compute requirements, building footprints, or power consumption for any listed tool, so it cannot support conclusions about grid constraints or infrastructure scaling.
